acceptance: none claimed; self-run checks below are author feedback only

changedPaths.change: Added '### Maintained setup owner reuse (RC4 setup020)' in 'Admission boundary and established internal values': one installed module instance; publicCaller.invoke hands the actual constructed DefinitionCall to runInstalledDefinitionCallTransport; owner-verified artifact and exact request relation retained; compact coordinates, SDK outcome, close and timing recorded as evidence only; no re-ingestion of persisted projections; cold/raw ingress and new Products still verify; installs keep physical checks and locks; owners keep permissions/currentness/close/reopen; no legacy mode, cache, service or receipt authority; setup PATH/TMPDIR scoped over the serial setup and restored in finally; one named cold entry for lifecycle and fresh reads; no timeout race. Includes a small sequence diagram.

publicCaller.invoke now calls runtime.api.runInstalledDefinitionCallTransport(transportAcquisition(call), call) with the actual constructed call; records calls/<label>.request.json (compact coordinates: acquisitionKind, definitionKey, invocationRef/Digest, request/resources/eventResource digests), calls/<label>.outcome.json (actual SDK outcome) and calls/<label>.close.json; state.calls carries exitCode, outcomeKind, acquisitionKind, closeDigest, started, wallMs. Removed setup JSONL write, per-op CLI child and stdout parser. Added exported transportAcquisition(call) and private withSetupEnvironment (PATH/TMPDIR assigned for the whole populateSandbox scope, ambient restored in finally; explicit environment required). populateSandbox wraps the unchanged serial body populateInstalledSetup. cliTransportJsonl retained for the cold entry and continuation consumers. No timeout race.

Added exported invokeColdInstalledEntry(caller,label,call,{runtimeRoot,environment}): one canonical JSONL request to a fresh installed cli.js process under its declared environment, one-line outcome parse, close recorded. freshReadbacks and invokeLifecycle use it (lifecycle keeps its supervision environment).

Adapted three existing controlled cases to the named cold entry (lifecycle dispatch args/environment; fresh read requests carry reopen acquisition and exact invocation; refusal case caller doubles). Appended provider-free real case 'Maintained setup retains actual owner verification through ten native calls and preserves configured environment' with the specified coverage; writes archive maintained-setup-proof.json and test-only artifacts/setup020/{preparation-resolve-call.json,preparation-resolve-receipt.json,maintained-setup-proof.json} (flag wx).

Conditional path, passive provenance relation only: the retained preparation receipt is read as the sibling '-receipt.json' of ABI5_PREPARATION_RESOLVE_CALL instead of the '/calls/'->'/receipts/' mapping, which cannot resolve for artifacts/setup020/preparation-resolve-call.json. Assertions unchanged.

untouchedConditionalPaths.reason: No demonstrated environment/dry-guard relation: its extra view/conformance calls are eventless (no lock namespace or npm dependence), and calls/catalog-admit.outcome.json is still recorded with the full SDK outcome.

residuals: End-to-end proof of the new harness case belongs to C2 on the freshly built and packaged candidate. Its assertions for the authorized call shape (call.resources.admissionAuthority.basis.ownerArtifact.{verified,request}) were desk-checked against the source admission_authority.ts at custody but not executed: verified is expected to keep identity (v.custom); request is checked by canonical deepEqual plus selectOwnedProductVerification, because valibot rebuilds it.

The new case requires artifacts/<package>.tgz matching test_env/fixtures/abi5-root-candidate-basis.json (readCandidateBasis), an npm executable on the ambient PATH with the offline cache usable, and /usr/bin/tar. It writes artifacts/setup020/* with flag wx, so it is not rerunnable without removing that directory.

t287-w2-05 'preparation resolution retains its established native link and raw lock refusals' skips unless ABI5_PREPARATION_RESOLVE_CALL is set; C2 must point it at artifacts/setup020/preparation-resolve-call.json after the harness run so the required case does not skip.

Only PATH and TMPDIR are scoped in-process. Install npm now inherits the remaining ambient process environment, as the grant states, instead of the old exclusive child environment. Any other toolchainEnvironment keys (e.g. npm_config_*) from config.setupEnvironment no longer reach the install npm unless already ambient.

exact-candidate-qualification.mjs still reads the recorded calls/catalog-admit.outcome.json and issues in-process eventless calls outside the setup env scope. That re-ingestion is pre-existing qualification behavior, not setup, and is outside this increment.

The new case's assertion that type programs occur only in core-initial-verification, consumer-verification and after:product-verify-1 assumes the candidate's consumer verification and lock link match the rc3-observed counts. A candidate whose consumer verification builds a declaration closure program still passes (it is allowed in consumer-verification); a second link program fails (<=1).
Phase timings are measured and reported (t.diagnostic and maintained-setup-proof.json). No timing target is asserted.
